architecturalAlignment.analysis: All three specifications follow the same architectural pattern: move learning logic from opencode to rpc-api. Each specification implements a different aspect of the learning system:

layerSeparation.responsibilities: Data collection, HTTP POST to rpc-api

8. Results inform future activity context requirements
